messages:
paula: quick flag from the periodic access review: found ~7 service accounts with roles/cloudkms.* spanning prod+staging and several are ownerless. seems like onboarding jobs got overprivileged.

igor: can you share the query and sampling criteria? want to reproduce for other projects.

paula: sure. query on BigQuery audit export: `SELECT principalEmail, resourceName, COUNT(*) FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*` WHERE protoPayload.serviceName='cloudkms.googleapis.com' AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) GROUP BY principalEmail, resourceName HAVING COUNT(*)>1`

maya: sounds right. propose a three-tier approach: MARK (identify unsafe), CANARY (test on 1-2 nonprod svcaccts), ROLL (phased removal).

lin: what metrics for canary? decrypt failures, AccessDenied spikes, job error rate?

paula: yes. primary signals: cloudkms AccessDenied by principal, related job failure count, and incident pager noise. thresholds: >3 AccessDenied in 30m or >5 job failures in 24h = rollback.

igor: prefer editing key-level IAM (scoped rebind) rather than blanket org role removal. snapshot policy before change: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ${KEY} > pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json` and copy to GS.

audit-bot: recorded: snapshot saved to gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/3456000000/pre-policy.json (owner=paula). Ticket KMS-3301 created (owner=igor).

paula: rollback snippet if needed: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ${KEY} --member='serviceAccount:svc@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'` — we'll keep exact prior blob for restore.

maya: consider conditional binding during canary instead of full revoke. example condition: `expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-15T00:00:00Z")`. less blast radius.

lin: compliance asked for short justification per revoke. draft template: - pre-policy path - observed risk (ownerless/multi-project exposure) - mitigation (scoped key + rotate) - verification steps (no AccessDenied spikes, job success).

igor: plan timeline: canary start 2026-03-30 09:00 PT, run 24h on svc-test-01, if green schedule phased rollout 5/day. paula will post greps/logs here.

paula: action items: PAULA run canary + paste logs; IGOR prepare rollback automation & snapshot; MAYA add conditional binding example to runbook; LIN will prepare compliance sign-off. target decision by 2026-03-31 EOD.

paula: keeping thread for audit trail — please reply here only for changes.
